content.title: Shortlist banana hai?
content.subtitle: Dost ki list copy mat karo. Apni profile se shuru karo.

steps.title: Apni profile likho
steps.detail: GPA, test scores, experience aur budget. Sab ek jagah.

steps.title: Real data dekho
steps.detail: Apne jaise profiles ka result dekho, accepted bhi aur rejected bhi.
steps.tip: Admit Finder pe course aur intake se filter karo.

steps.title: Courses filter karo
steps.detail: Country, level aur intake chuno. Fees pehle dekho, phir dil lagao.
steps.tip: Course Finder mein ye saare filters hain.

steps.title: Teen bucket banao
steps.detail: Dream, target aur safe. Har bucket mein kuch universities.

steps.title: Deadline ke saath list
steps.detail: Final list mein har university ki deadline aur documents likh do.

caption:
Shortlist banana sabse confusing step lagta hai. 5 steps mein simple karo 👇

1. Apni profile likho
2. Real data dekho
3. Courses filter karo
4. Teen bucket banao
5. Deadline ke saath list

Save karo 📌 aur us dost ko bhejo jise iski zaroorat hai.

👉 app.goeduabroad.com
